notes: Keeps your plugins healthy over long sessions: every plugin running inside the hub is now restarted automatically every 10 minutes (set the interval, or 0 to turn it off, on the Diagnostics page, which also shows uptime and restart counts). A plugin that is busy, for example mid-cast or mid-run, is left alone until it is done. Chat Reader, Minimap Compass, Gear Inspector and Mass Abandon now move into the hub too. Also fixes a path problem in plugin installs and makes hosted.json saves crash-safe.
